label: Every actual root withholds each grounded being, from uniform giving at the root
description: Argument N2, the uniformity route of #1944's gap 1 and #1897's gap 6. Not a transcription: the root's two-way profile toward the contingents is derived (controls, law 2), not assumed, and without #1897's holder premises. Establishes no premise. The decisive premise is uniformity at the root, which one power, an invariant set-up and willed exercise do not entail (controls, mixed-mode root). Its warrant is weak: on the theist's own account one will is necessary toward its own goodness and free toward other things, and the Son is begotten by nature (note section 4). Omission models: without uniformity (the mixed-mode root), without (b), without factive giving, without necessary roots, without some contingent concretum, without the common root (a mediated creator). Same premise choice as N1: 0c27f65a stands for the bare common root a6b46d2e.
